name: Koezaru wa Akai Hana Special Disk ~Tsuki no Ura yori Koishitau~
original_name: 越えざるは紅い花 スペシャルディスク ～月の裏より恋い慕う～
source: This special  disc retells scenes from the main game from the perspectives of seven male characters: Toya, Soren, Nooru, Ruzi, Naran, Sef, and Esta
translation: 本张特别光盘从七位男性角色的视角重新演绎了本篇中的诸多场景：托亚、斯兰、诺尔、卢奇、纳兰、赛夫与埃斯塔。
